releases.changelog:
### Added & Improved
- **Floating OLED Glass Capsule Header in Home & Song Party**: Elevated the home screen and song party lobby with dynamic morphing island headers! When scrolling down, the static full-width bar seamlessly animates into a floating OLED frosted glass capsule with 20px Gaussian blur, a subtle hairline border, ambient color glow reflection (sampled from Speed Dial artwork on Home, and neon party purple in Song Party), and fluid typography/avatar scaling.
- **Dynamic Heart & Vinyl Record Collage Thumbnails**: Upgraded the generic flat icon thumbnails in the Library with interactive dynamic album cover art! Liked Songs now forms a heart-shaped photo collage out of your favorite track covers with a neon gradient heart border and glass sheen, while Recently Played forms a circular vinyl record with real recent album covers, concentric vinyl grooves, center history spindle, and ambient radial sheen.
- **Double-Tap Mini Player to Like / Unlike**: Double tapping anywhere on the mini player / bottom player now instantly likes or unlikes the currently playing song with tactile haptic feedback, a delightful animated pink heart pop burst overlay, and a toast confirmation—without ever having to open the full now-playing screen.
- **Configurable Dynamic View Types (List, 2×2 Grid & 3×3 Dense Grid)**: Browse **Library**, **Liked Songs**, and **Recently Played** your way with a single-tap view switcher in the action bar. Switch seamlessly between the detailed List view, a comfortable 2×2 cover grid with 1:1 artwork cards, and a dense 3×3 grid for rapid visual scanning—complete with full multi-selection, live playing indicators, context menus, and persistent layout preferences across all library views.
- **Revamped OLED Create & Edit Playlist Dialog**: Redesigned playlist creation and editing with a frosted glassmorphic backdrop, gradient emblem branding, selected track count badges, interactive 3-segment visibility cards (Private, Public, Unlisted), smooth collaborative playlist toggles, and glowing gradient action buttons.
- **Two-Way Recently Played Sync with `dhunik-cache`**: Seamlessly synchronizes listening history bidirectionally with the cloud cache (`dhunik-cache`), automatically restoring recently played tracks upon sign-in, persisting plays in the background with zero latency, and merging offline tracks conflict-free.
- **Multi-Select & Batch Actions in Liked Songs**: Select multiple tracks in Liked Songs to bulk-add them to existing playlists, create a new playlist on the fly, play immediately, or remove with a floating glassmorphic action bar.
- **Move to Liked Songs from Playlists**: Quickly move any track from inside a playlist directly into your Liked Songs library with a single tap in the context menu.
- **Instant Playlist Song Removal**: Removing or moving a song from any playlist now updates the tracklist instantly in real time without requiring a pull-to-refresh.
- **Atomic Playlist Creation with Initial Tracks**: Creating a new playlist with songs selected on the fly now immediately populates and synchronizes all tracks locally and to the cloud.
- **Fixed Bottom Sheet Mini-Player Stacking**: Fixed modal bottom sheets (song context menus, search sheets, and dialogs) getting obscured behind the floating mini-player by ensuring root navigator presentation.
- Party page cosmetic and other bug fixes and optimizations.

### Added & Improved
- **Smartwatch & Wear OS Queue Sync**: View your full music queue, see track position, and jump to any song directly from your smartwatch.
- **Language-Driven Artist Discovery**: Picking your preferred languages now automatically tailors the artists you see to your regional taste.
- **High-Definition Artist Photos**: Fixed missing artist pictures across the app so every artist now has a crisp, clear image.
- **Personalized Home Recommendations**: Quick Picks and Speed Dial now feature the artists and languages you chose during setup.
- **Your Artists on Home Screen**: Added a dedicated section on the home page featuring your favorite artists.
- **Multi-Language Trending Hits**: Trending songs, albums, and featured playlists now reflect all of your selected languages together.
- **Lyrics Script & Transliteration Setup**: Added a setup step to pick how you want your lyrics displayed (Romanized English, Native Script, or Original) for effortless sing-alongs.
- **Compact Lyrics Script Switcher**: Replaced the hidden long-press button with an intuitive split pill that lets you toggle transliteration with a single tap or switch scripts instantly via the dropdown chevron.
- **Player Aesthetic Setup**: Personalize your bottom player look right from the start with interactive previews for Floating Stadium Pill, Full Width Docked Bar, and Floating Vinyl Disc.
- **Revamped Flagship About Showcase**: Redesigned the About page with an animated ambient breathing aura, modern flagship feature highlights (15-band EQ, AutoEq, Wear OS sync, phonetic AI lyrics), tech engineering chips, and polished glassmorphic community links.
- **Revamped OLED Account & Profile Hub**: Modernized the account screen with an elegant horizontal profile card, ambient dynamic glow, 2x2 quick-access shortcuts for Equalizer, Settings, Downloads, and Stats, plus streamlined grouped preferences.
- **Revamped Premium Sign-In Prompt**: Redesigned the authentication modal with dynamic feature-tailored headers, glowing hero emblem, OLED glass feature badges, and status-bar safe layout.
- **Smart Lyrics Transliteration Account Gating**: Lyrics transliteration is now seamlessly connected with account sign-in, with instant access upon authentication.
- **Revamped Pre-Search & Discovery Hub**: Redesigned the search pre-state to match Spotify and YouTube Music standards with clean recent search tiles (complete with insert arrow and single-tap remove), a visual "Trending Now" carousel featuring cover artwork, rankings, and play badges, plus Top Charts.
- **Revamped Active Search Results Experience**: Brought Spotify & Apple Music standards to active queries with a prominent "Top Result" Best Match hero card (with 1-tap playback), brand-gradient floating pill filter tabs, 2-column cover artwork grids for Albums and Playlists, and a 3-column circular avatar grid for Artists.
- **Unified Browse All Experience**: Consolidated the redundant Explore page into Search's pre-state with 2-column vibrant gradient cards and angled 3D artwork (`GenreMoodGridSection`), elevating discovery and streamlining app navigation.
- **True Floating Mini-Player Fix**: Fixed an issue where the Floating Stadium Pill and Dynamic Island were placed inside the bottom navigation slot, causing an opaque black bar on the left and right. They now genuinely float over the content and animated background with zero background occlusion.
- **Intuitive Floating Vinyl Disc Controls**: Updated the vinyl disc mini-player so tapping anywhere on the spinning disc opens the Now Playing page, while tapping the center glass icon toggles Play/Pause.

### Added & Improved
- **Studio-Grade Sound Engine**: A new custom audio engine delivers noticeably cleaner, richer sound with zero lag.
- **5, 10 & 15-Band Equalizer Modes**: Switch easily between simple 5-band, studio 10-band, and pro 15-band sliders for fine-tuned audio control.
- **Larger & Taller Sliders**: Greatly increased slider height and touch size, making it much easier to tune your music with precision.
- **Click-Free Sound Adjustments**: Changing presets or dragging sliders now transitions smoothly with zero pops, clicks, or audio glitches.
- **Real-Time Sound Wave Visualizer**: The frequency curve at the top now displays the exact shape of your audio tuning in real time.
- **Smart Anti-Distortion Shield**: Automatically prevents harsh clipping and distortion, even when you heavily boost the bass or treble.
- **Enhanced Headphone Profiles (AutoEq)**: Perfectly calibrates your sound to popular headphones like AirPods, Sony, and Sennheiser with studio accuracy.
- **Seamless Track Crossfade**: Smoothly blends the end of one song into the next without any drop in volume or musical energy.
- **Customizable Crossfade Length**: Easily adjust how long songs overlap (from instant gapless up to 12 seconds) right in Settings.
- **Smart DJ Silence Trimmer**: Automatically trims dead silence at the end of tracks so your music crossfades right into the beat.

### Added & Improved
- **Customizable Mini-Player Styles**: Personalize your bottom player aesthetic in Settings with selectable designs: Floating Stadium Pill, Full Width Docked Bar, or Floating Vinyl Disc
- **Mini-Player Quick Style Switcher**: Long-press anywhere on the bottom mini-player to instantly summon the style picker sheet with tactile haptic feedback
- **Interactive Track-Skip Swipe with Peek Glimpse**: Swiping left or right on the mini-player smoothly glides the album art and track details while revealing the incoming next or previous track's artwork, title, and tag in real time with spring physics, boundary resistance, and haptics, while keeping the docked player frame stationary
- **Dynamic Speed Dial Ambient Glow**: Home screen dual-tone ambient background dynamically extracts dominant palette colors from your Speed Dial song artwork with smooth cross-fade transitions and graceful fallbacks
- **Universal Playlist Import**: Transfer any public playlist from Spotify or YouTube Music with a single link
- **In-Playlist Song Recommendations**: Discover and add similar songs directly inside your playlists
- **Smart Link Detection Popup**: Automatically prompts to play or import copied Spotify & YouTube links on app open
- **Search Link Resolver**: Paste any Spotify or YouTube song link in search to play it instantly
- **Dynamic Queue Reordering**: Drag-and-drop to reorder songs in Up Next with tactile haptic feedback
- **Ghost Cache & Zero-Latency Gapless Audio**: Seamlessly pre-buffers upcoming queue tracks directly to a lightweight, bounded disk cache in the background, eliminating network buffering delays and dead air between songs with strict memory safety and LRU eviction
- **Apple Music-Style Animated Mesh Gradient**: Dynamic, fluid ambient glow on the Now Playing screen with smooth song-to-song color morphing, frosted diffusion, and zero-rebuild performance optimization
- **AutoEq Live Cloud Integration (8,800+ Headphone Models)**: Search and apply official laboratory-measured acoustic calibration data directly from Jaakko Pasanen's AutoEq database (oratory1990, Crinacle, Rtings, B&K 5128) with local disk caching and real-time hardware EQ sync
- **Interactive AutoEq Frequency Curve Preview**: Tap any headphone profile in the search list to inspect and preview its laboratory frequency response curve dynamically on the top visualizer in glowing amber before applying, complete with one-tap dismiss and zero audio interruption
- **Hardware-Level Loudness Normalization (Auto-Gain)**: Eliminates jarring volume jumps between quiet master tracks and loud YouTube rips automatically using Android's hardware  (EBU R128 standard) with quick toggles in Settings and the Equalizer Effects lab
- **Auto-Detect Links Setting**: Toggle copied link prompts anytime in Settings
- **New Playlist Menu**: Tap + to create a blank playlist or import an existing one
- **Playlists Discovery Banner**: Quick-access banner in Playlists makes imports effortless
- **Instant Playlist Playback**: Newly imported playlists now load and stream immediately
- **Bottom Nav Search**: Moved search to the bottom navigation bar for quick access

### Added & Performance Optimizations
- **Massive APK Size Reduction**: Reduced primary download size from ~88.5 MB down to ~30 MB (over 65% reduction)
- **Multi-Architecture Release Packaging**: Automated builds for modern 64-bit devices (), 32-bit devices (), and universal fallback
- **R8 / ProGuard Code & Resource Shrinking**: Minified bytecode and eliminated over 16 MB of unused dependency code with zero regressions
- **Asset Optimization**: Converted core assets to high-efficiency WebP and pruned redundant legacy assets
- Guaranteed 100% stability across background playback, lock-screen notifications, YouTube stream extraction, and offline downloads
